text:
incident-bot: ALERT: service-prefill-gpu reported repeated OOMs and container restarts in us-west-2a/us-west-2b (prefill path) — paging oncall
oncall-eric: acked, joining bridge now
morgan: seeing 503s and restart count spikes on prefills. Killed containers show OOM-kill in kernel logs. Possible long-context customer
sre-jen: copying recent container log snippet:
``` 
E tensorflow/core/common_runtime/gpu/gpu_process_state.cc: Out of memory while allocating 12.3 GiB
Container exited with status 137
stack trace: cudaDriverApi::cuMemAlloc -> cuCtxCreate -> __gthread_start
```
sanjay: `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep prefill` -> 3/10 pods in CrashLoopBackOff across 2 nodes. node-12 showing dmesg OOM messages. Also disk pressure low.
opsbot: Auto-scaler triggered warm-pool but warm nodes are unhealthy in zone us-west-2b, marking for replacement
morgan: root cause seems correlated with a customer sending triage: single request with ~450k tokens (long pasted logs) into prefill route, caused memory blowout during KV cache allocation
sre-jen: mitigations in-flight:
- set global prefill token soft-limit to 100k
- enable immediate fallback to quantized-8bit model variant for prefills
- emergency routing: shift prefills to dedicated-hosts pool (no multi-tenant) for affected orgs
sanjay: executed commands:
`kubectl patch configmap inference-routes -p '{"data":{"prefill_max_tokens":"100000"}}'`
`./ops/reroute.sh --route prefills --to dedicated-hosts --filter org:acme`
opsbot: routing change applied, rate limiter updated for prefills (burst=10/min -> 2/min)
customer-success-alyssa: notifying impacted customer (Acme). Drafting status: "We observed abnormal large-context request triggering GPU OOMs; we're applying protections and routing to dedicated capacity to preserve availability. No data loss."
oncall-eric: live metrics look stabilizing: error rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% over last 6m. Some pods still restarting but new pods on dedicated poolHealthy
morgan: note: we should add request-length validation in the gateway to drop >200k token prefill at ingress
sre-jen: creating follow-up ticket: INF-7893 add ingress prefill size guard, add per-org prefix caching limits, and add telemetry for single-request token counts
customer-success-alyssa: will send interim customer update after ops confirm stability
lucy: taking night oncall handoff at 23:30 PDT — will monitor restart count and CPU/GPU mem trends, ping if error rate >2% or new segfaults
oncall-eric: handing off: full notes above. bridge clear from me, please escalate to infra if node flaps continue. :thumbsup:
